rec.name: Team Introduction Section ("Dein Team")
rec.status: Built — tested internally, documentation done (v1.1 wishes tracked in a subtask)

what.text: A section that introduces the team behind the shop, typically with a photo, name and role per team member. It was built for the homepage and is added through the theme editor under Sections. Team members can be added individually; a tester added one extra member during QA.

why.text: Showing real people humanizes the brand and reduces the anonymity of an online shop. This builds trust and a sense of accountability, which is especially useful for first-time visitors, high-consideration products and small or founder-led brands. The ticket does not state this rationale, so it is inferred from general CRO principles.

how.text: Add the section on the homepage via Theme Editor > Add section. Each team member is a repeatable item (photo, name, role), and non-developers can add or edit them. The section was built and tested in the 'sectionfy.io' theme (test copy). Internal QA by several team members found no issues. The full build spec is in the Slite documentation 'CRO | Global | Dein Team', which was not available for this record.

items: Repeatable team member items: photo, name, role (inferred; a tester confirmed members can be added)
Colors and spacing via theme editor (inferred)

dependencies.text: No metafields appear to be needed (the custom field reads 'MF/N', interpreted as 'no metafield'). It requires a Shopify Online Store 2.0 theme with section support, here the sectionfy.io theme. No apps are mentioned.

items: Bounce rate and scroll depth to the section
